mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, sku_code, spec_json, spec_key, price, stock, status FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, product_id, sku_code, spec_json, spec_key, price, stock, status FROM product_sku WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId} AND stock >= #{quantity} AND status = 1
UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId}
UPDATE products p SET p.stock = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.stock), 0) FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status = 1), p.update_time = NOW() WHERE p.id = #{productId}
